title: Learning Course Protocol (LCP)
description: JSON Schema for LearnByDiff course.jsonc and chapter JSONC documents. Wire via the $schema property. Protocol evolves additively; all course.jsonc fields are optional.

sourceDirPath.description: Directory path relative to the source repository root (or source.root). Nested paths allowed; no absolute paths or '..' segments.

relativeFilePath.description: File path relative to the chapter snapshot tree root (inside fromDir / toDir).

changedFile.description: One file that differs between fromDir and toDir.

path.description: Path relative to the chapter snapshot tree root.

kind.description: U added in toDir, M modified, D deleted from fromDir.

gitignorePattern.description: A .gitignore-style pattern relative to the learning folder root. Leading '/' anchors to that root; a pattern without '/' matches in any directory. Trailing '/' matches directories only.

repository.description: Git repository URL (clone remote only; do not append a subdirectory), local filesystem path, or omit. Defaults to `.` (the directory that contains course.jsonc). Relative local paths resolve from that same directory.

root.description: Optional subdirectory under repository that prefixes every chapter fromDir / toDir.

course.description: All fields optional. Defaults: id from course home (or `{repo}-learn` at a git root), title=id, source.repository=`.` (directory that contains course.jsonc), chaptersDir=`chapters` (next to course.jsonc), retain=`["node_modules"]` (explicit `[]` keeps no author paths).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL or path for this course document.

id.description: Stable course id (also used as the default learning workspace folder name). Defaults from the course home directory.

title.description: Human-readable course title. Defaults to id.

chaptersDir.description: Directory of chapter JSONC files, relative to the directory that contains course.jsonc. Defaults to `chapters`. Nested paths allowed; no absolute paths or '..' segments.

retain.description: .gitignore-style patterns for paths a snapshot replace must not delete. Matching follows gitignore rules from the learning folder root (e.g. `node_modules` keeps every `node_modules` directory). Omitted means `["node_modules"]`. Explicit `[]` keeps no author paths.

chapter.description: All fields optional. Defaults: id from filename (strip numeric prefix), title=id, empty fromDir/toDir = empty trees, omitted entryFiles = all files under toDir, omitted changedFiles = classify at runtime.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL or path for this chapter document.

id.description: Stable chapter id (unique within the course). Defaults from the jsonc filename.

title.description: Human-readable chapter title. Defaults to id.

fromDir.description: Start snapshot directory under the source repo (or source.root). Empty = empty start tree.

toDir.description: Goal snapshot directory under the source repo (or source.root). Empty = empty goal tree.

entryFiles.description: Optional paths relative to the chapter snapshot tree root. When omitted, all files under toDir are used.

changedFiles.description: Optional from/to diffs (path + U/M/D) filled when creating the course. Omitted = classify at runtime. Empty = chapter unchanged.

docs.description: Optional chapter documentation: an http(s) URL, or a file path relative to the chapter snapshot tree (toDir / fromDir), e.g. README.md or notes/guide.pdf.
